```{r}
library(MASS)
```
```{r}
data("Boston")
Boston=data.frame(Boston)
```
```{r}
?Boston
```
```{r}
View(Boston)
```
```{r}
dim(Boston)
```
```{r}
crim_med = rep(0, nrow(Boston))
crim_med[Boston$crim > median(Boston$crim)] = 1
Boston = data.frame(Boston, crim_med)
set.seed(312)
train=sample(nrow(Boston),size = 0.75*nrow(Boston))
length(train)
```
```{r}
glm.fit=glm(crim_med~., data = Boston,subset = train, family = "binomial")
```
```{r}
summary(glm.fit)
```
```{r}
glm_probs = predict(glm.fit, Boston[-train, ], type = "response")
glm_pred = rep("No", dim(Boston[-train, ])[1])
glm_pred[glm_probs > 0.5] = "Yes"
table(glm_pred, Boston[-train, "crim_med"], dnn = c("Predicted","Actual"))
```
